experiments.experiment: NLU-07 — Read -> said -> read: does meaning survive a round trip?
notes: `_triple_sentence` is the ONE place a held fact becomes words, so this measures understanding against expression: what the substrate SAYS of a claim must read back as the same claim
cannot judge the article in “a robin is a bird” — the store holds no word class for the complement
cannot judge the article in “a vault is a locked” — the store holds no word class for the complement
cannot judge the article in “a dog is an animal” — the store holds no word class for the complement
cannot judge the article in “a robin is not a mammal” — the store holds no word class for the complement
said back: 'A robin is a bird.' -> “a robin is a bird”
said back: 'The vault is locked.' -> “a vault is a locked”
said back: 'A dog is an animal.' -> “a dog is an animal”
said back: 'A robin is not a mammal.' -> “a robin is not a mammal”

experiments.experiment: NLU-08 — Does it ANSWER the question, or recite what it holds?
notes: runs the real conversation path — understand() then say() — which STORES what it is told; the taught claims below enter the store
asked “What does a glarnick shape?” -> “A glarnick shapes metal.”

asked “Is a glarnick heavy?” -> “I remember: A glarnick shapes metal.
A glarnick is a tool. It shapes metal.
I hold nothing for heavy. Tell me what it is and I will keep it.”

asked “What is a glarnick?” -> “I remember: A glarnick shapes metal.
A glarnick is a tool. It shapes metal.”

checks.name: does not recite everything for 'What does a glarnick shape?'
checks.detail: reply names 1 of the 3 held facts

checks.name: does not recite everything for 'Is a glarnick heavy?'
checks.detail: reply names 3 of the 3 held facts

checks.name: does not recite everything for 'What is a glarnick?'
checks.detail: reply names 2 of the 3 held facts

experiments.experiment: NLU-09 — When it cannot represent a sentence, does it SAY so?
notes: the false-positive rate is the safety number here: a reading becomes a premise the solver cannot doubt, so a confident wrong reading is worse than no reading at all
false-positive rate on structures it cannot represent: 25.0% (3/12)
